title: Indonesian tin miner eyes mining asset in Canada
body: Arsari Tambang says it will take advantage of an economic partnership deal signed with Canada last month to invest in a mining asset there.

title: Column: Tin breaks higher as Indonesia cracks down on illegal miners
body: The tin market is once again bubbling on supply chain trouble, this time in Indonesia.

title: Indonesia expects deal soon with Freeport-McMoRan on divestment plan
body: Last week, Freeport declared force majeure at Grasberg after torrential mudslides that killed two workers.

title: Minerba Convex 2025 Opens in Jakarta, Showcasing Digitalization, Inclusive Mining, and Indonesia’s Export Growth
body: The Minerba Convex 2025 forum opened in Jakarta with over 6,000 participants, unveiling the Minerba One digital platform and stressing inclusive mining, while highlighting Indonesia’s nikel export surge to US$40 billion in 2024 and a PNBP contribution of Rp654 trillion from 2019‑2024. The event also called for redistributing mining permits to local UMKM, expanding community education programs, and accelerating downstream processing for commodities such as copper, bauxite, and low‑calorific coal for DME projects.
